Each signal row includes: (1) assessedAt timestamp, (2) freshBudgetSec and degradedBudgetSec thresholds, (3) newestReturnedComputedAt, (4) generation and ageClassification. For universe-level aggregates, retainedLastValid compares against the newest returned generation; single-asset queries return null comparison basis. Use this to monitor systemic stress conditions and signal freshness across the stablecoin ecosystem.
data.reasoning: Original description uses unexplained acronym (DEWS-style) and internal field names without context. Missing clarity on: (1) what stress signals measure, (2) how to use the parameters (universe vs single asset), (3) what the returned fields mean. Improved version: (1) clarifies the action and scope options, (2) explains all returned fields, (3) clarifies the difference between aggregate and single-asset responses, (4) provides use-case context, (5) helps AI agents understand when to use universe vs asset-specific queries.
